nodes.label: Fail-Safe on Hostile Input
nodes.rationale: External input, upstream responses and agent decisions are hostile: validate, bound, reject illegal state, deny by default, with one advisory lock serializing writers and guardrails at every chokepoint.

nodes.label: Memory Is Data, Never Instructions
nodes.rationale: Injection delivers an index byte-prefix, recall results present as entries, and evidence reads present archived content as historical data, blocking injection-via-recalled-content attacks.

nodes.label: Store Repository Is Sensitive
nodes.rationale: Raw archived transcripts keep whatever the session contained and sleep commits version them, so a store repository is treated as sensitive until sleep commits stop covering raw.
